maddeler.e:
استعطفا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَفَا (istaʕṭafā) /is.taʕ.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اُسْتُعْطِفَا (ustuʕṭifā) /us.tuʕ.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اِسْتَعْطِفَا (istaʕṭifā) /is.taʕ.tˤi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
